app.name: Business plan for the bank
app.tagline: Write a bank-ready business plan for an Estonian loan, step by step.

footer.disclaimer: This is a planning tool, not legal, tax or financial advice. Check important decisions with a professional.

home.title: Get your business plan ready for the bank
home.intro: Answer simple questions about your business. The app turns them into a clear plan that follows what Estonian banks expect.
home.feature1Text: Step-by-step questions, from your idea to collateral. AI helps you write clear text.
home.feature2Text: Three-year forecast, loan schedule and the key ratios banks check. Estonian taxes built in.
home.feature3Text: Before you go to the bank, an AI credit officer finds weak points and asks hard questions.
home.deleted: Your account and all your data have been deleted.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Enter your email. We send you a link — click it to log in. No password needed.
login.sentText: We sent a login link to your email. Open it on this device and in this browser.
login.errorInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
login.errorGeneric: We could not send the link. Please try again in a few minutes.
login.errorLink: The login link did not work or has expired. Please ask for a new one.

plans.title: My plans
plans.empty: You have no plans yet. Create your first one below.
plans.errorInvalid: Please give the plan a name and choose the type of business.
plans.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

plan.placeholder: The questions for this section are added in the next development phase.

summary.title: Summary
summary.hint: A short overview: what you do, how much you want to borrow, and why the bank will get its money back. You write it last, but it comes first.

idea.title: Business idea
idea.hint: Your product or service, the problem it solves, and why now is the right time.

market.title: Market and competitors
market.hint: How big the market is, who your main competitors are, and why customers will choose you.

customers.title: Customers
customers.hint: Who buys from you, how many customers you expect, and any first customers or agreements you already have.

team.title: Team
team.hint: The owners and key people, their experience, and who does what.

marketing.title: Marketing and sales
marketing.hint: How customers find you, your prices, sales channels and marketing budget.

operations.title: Operations
operations.hint: Location, equipment, suppliers, and the licences and permits you need.

risks.title: Risks
risks.hint: The main risks and how you reduce each one. Banks value owners who have thought this through.

loan.title: Loan purpose and amount
loan.hint: What the money is for, how much you need, for how long, and how you plan to pay it back.

ownContribution.title: Own contribution
ownContribution.hint: How much of your own money goes into the project and where it comes from. Banks often ask for 10–30%.

collateral.title: Collateral
collateral.hint: What secures the loan: real estate, a personal guarantee, or a guarantee from EIS (Enterprise Estonia).

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteText: This deletes your login and all your plans for good. It cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirm: I understand that everything will be deleted.
settings.deleteError: We could not delete your account. Please try again.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.draftNote: Draft. The company details of the service provider will be added before launch.
privacy.whatText: Your email address (to log you in) and the business plans you write. We do not ask for your name, ID code, address or phone number.
privacy.whereText: In a database in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany). Only you can see your plans.
privacy.aiText: When you use the AI helper or the bank officer check, the text of your plan is sent to Anthropic, the company that provides the AI. Your email is not sent.
privacy.deleteText: You can delete your account and all your plans at any time in Settings.

finance.title: Numbers and loan calculator
finance.intro: Enter your expected sales, costs and loan. Amounts are without VAT. The results below update as you type.
finance.saveError: Could not save. Please check the numbers and try again.
finance.invalid: Some numbers are not valid (for example a negative amount or more interest-only months than the loan term). Fix them to see the results.

sales.title: Sales
sales.hint: One line per main product or service.
sales.name: Product or service
sales.empty: No sales yet. Add your first product or service.

costs.title: Running costs
costs.hint: Rent, utilities, marketing, accounting, insurance and other monthly costs.
costs.name: Cost

staff.title: Staff
staff.hint: Gross monthly pay. Employer taxes are added automatically.
staff.minimum: Full-time job here (minimum social tax applies)

financing.title: Own money and loan
financing.own: Own money put in at the start

owner.title: Owner
owner.dividends: Dividends paid at the end of each year
owner.drawings: Money the owner takes out per month (living costs)
owner.exemption: Owner's tax-free income is used here (not by an employer)

results.title: Results
results.dscrHint: Banks and EIS look for at least {minimum}.
results.incomeTaxesFie: Owner's taxes (social tax, income tax, pension)
results.cashflow: Cash flow in year 1, month by month
results.how1: Taxes and rates come from Estonian law and the Tax and Customs Board, checked on {date}.
results.how2: Wages: employer adds 33% social tax (at least on the monthly minimum for a full-time employee) and 0.8% unemployment insurance. Payroll taxes and VAT are paid the next month.
results.how3: OÜ: profit kept in the company is not taxed. A dividend costs 22/78 of its amount in tax.
results.how4: FIE: social tax, income tax and pension are worked out per calendar year and paid as the law sets (quarterly advances, the rest on 1 October of the next year).
results.how5: DSCR = (EBITDA − income taxes − FIE owner's drawings) ÷ (loan principal + interest paid in the year). Purchases are assumed to carry 24% VAT.

warnings.title: Check these
warnings.ok: No warnings: the forecast meets the bank benchmarks we check.
warnings.negativeCash: Cash runs out in {month}. The lowest point is {amount}. Add own money, borrow more, or lower costs.
warnings.lowDscr: Year {year}: DSCR is {value}. Banks look for at least {minimum}.
warnings.lowCurrentRatio: Year {year}: current ratio is {value}. EIS looks for at least {minimum}.
warnings.lowEquityRatio: Year {year}: equity is {value} of total assets. EIS looks for at least {minimum}.
warnings.highDebtToTurnover: Year {year}: the loan left is {value} of yearly sales. EIS recommended at most {maximum}.
warnings.vatRegistrationNeeded: {year}: taxable sales of {turnover} are above the {threshold} limit. You must register for VAT.
warnings.dividendsAboveProfit: Year {year}: dividends are larger than the profit earned so far.

assumptions.title: Values not yet confirmed
assumptions.intro: These values are not fixed by law yet. We used the last known value:
assumptions.socialTaxMonthlyMinBase: social tax minimum monthly base for {year}
